name: 43146 · Orient, OH
findings: ZIP 43146 (Orient) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43146 (Orient) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 43146 (Orient) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
